decisions.executionNote: Raise both arms into continuous elbow-up approaches. Plan white basket for rabbits, red for cameras, central blue for pens.
Approach first rabbit with left and back camera with right, progressively pitching downward above the objects.
Fine descent to rabbit torso and camera center; keep grippers open until alignment is visible.
Close around rabbit torso and camera, then lift a short distance to check retention visually.
Both objects appear retained. Lift clear of basket rims and carry rabbit left, camera right, with grippers closed.
Replan after continuity guard: smaller forward increments while lowering reduce reach. Position retained objects inside their respective baskets before releasing.
Release first rabbit into white and camera into red, allow settling, then withdraw upward and backward.
First objects are visible inside their baskets. Approach the remaining rabbit and camera from above, keeping each arm on its own side.
Fine lateral alignment and slow descent around the second rabbit's torso and remaining camera, leaving both grippers open.
Close on the aligned rabbit and camera, pause for seating, then make a short vertical lift to verify both grasps from RGB.
Rabbit appears retained; carry it outward and up. Camera remained on table, so reopen right gripper and descend more deeply for a new grasp.
Bring second rabbit toward a free part of white basket. Refine camera alignment, close right gripper, and test retention with a small lift.
Set and release second rabbit inside white basket. Camera now appears held; transport it upward and toward red basket with right gripper closed.
Withdraw left from rabbits and approach white pen area above the table. Lower retained second camera into an unoccupied part of red basket.
Release second camera and withdraw right. Orient left gripper across the white pen and descend above it; pen alignment remains uncertain.
Descend left to the white pen and close across its shaft. Approach black pen with right while turning the fingers perpendicular to its length.
After rotation continuity rejection, reduce right wrist increments. Align and close left on white pen, then lift briefly; continue right approach to black pen.
White pen appears retained. Carry it toward central basket while lowering right around black pen, closing, and beginning a short retention check.
Carry white pen above the left half of blue basket. Lift black pen for confirmation and keep right arm separated while left places first.
Replan with smaller increments after left continuity rejection. Lower and modestly tilt white pen into blue basket; stage held black pen on the right without arm overlap.
White pen is over the blue interior; release without extending farther, then reverse the approach. Bring black pen toward the blue basket from the right.
White pen is visibly settled in blue. Clear left arm away while lowering the retained black pen into the right half of blue, using small increments.
Release black pen over blue interior without pushing reach farther, then withdraw right. Begin a gradual open-gripper return of left arm toward origin.
Both pens are visible in blue, rabbits in white, cameras in red. Return both open grippers toward their starting poses with gradual wrist unwinding and elbow-up continuity.
No steps executed in rejected chunk. Halve right retreat and rotation increments to satisfy joint continuity; continue gradual left return.
Finish left return to its starting pose and continue right retreat and wrist unwinding. Keep both grippers open while sorted objects settle.
Return right arm to its original pose with continuous small motions, then hold both arms open at origin. Check that all categories remain inside their separate baskets.
